bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to public safety; castration or sterilization of minors prohibited; imposing criminal penalties; proposing coding for new law in Minnesota Statutes, chapter 609.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.

[609.2248] CASTRATION OR STERILIZATION OF MINORS PROHIBITED.

A person who does either of the following to a person under the age of 18 years is guilty of a felony:

(1) physical or chemical castration; or

(2) any surgery, procedure, or administration of drugs that results in the person being unable to conceive a child.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective August 1, 2025, and applies to crimes committed on or after that date.
